headline: Smarter naming, and approved cuts left alone.
notes: Names like v1_WIP01 now version to v1_WIP02 (REV, R and DRAFT work the same way) instead of getting _001 added on the end
Versioning an approved cut leaves it untouched in your approved bin, and puts the new version back in your working folder
Select a sequence in the Project panel to see all its versions, not only the one in the timeline – including versions made on another computer
Dates can now be written year first (2026-10-07), the only order that sorts by date in a bin
Settings > Naming: open the Click row to see examples of what a version up does with your settings
Fixed: a sequence's version history could disappear after the project was saved under a new name
Fixed: a small gap beside the Sequence tab when nothing was counted
